test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Annual production of four different types of cold drinks has been tabulated below. Which of these cold-drinks has encountered maximum percentage increment in production?

 
 

 **Cold drink**
 **2020 (units)**
 **2021 (units)**
 
 

 Sprite
 5400
 5800
 
 

 Coca-cola
 5300
 5600
 
 

 Pepsi
 6000
 6800
 
 

 Fanta
 1800
 2700
solution:
**Calculation:**

Production of sprite in 2020 = 5400

Production of sprite in 2021 = 5800 

Difference = 5800 - 5400 = 400

Percentage increment = 400/ 5400 × 100 = 7.40%

Production of coca- cola in 2020 = 5300

Production of coca- cola in 2021 = 5600

Difference = 5600 - 5300 = 300

Percentage increment = 300/5300 × 100 = 5.67%

Production of pepsi in 2020 = 6000

Production of pepsi in 2021 = 6800

Difference = 6800 - 6000 = 800

Percentage increment = 800/6000 × 100 = 13.33%

Production of fanta in 2020 = 1800

Production of fanta in 2021 = 2700

Difference = 2700 - 1800 = 900

Percentage increment = 900/1800 × 100 = 50%

**Hence, the percentage increment of Fanta is maximum among all the cold-drinks .**
